subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• In academic settings, the term symposium traditionally refers to a scholarly conference that occurs annually at a fixed university location.
• Such symposiums are held at Harvard, Oxford, and Stanford.
• In 2015, professors Aaliyah Washington and James Wilson established the innovative Global Nomad Symposium.
• The Global Nomad Symposium rotates between universities in different countries each year.
• The Global Nomad Symposium has followed an irregular timeline, with conferences in 2015, 2017–18, 2021, and 2023–24.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize a difference between the Global Nomad Symposium and traditional symposiums. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Unlike traditional symposiums, the Global Nomad Symposium rotates between universities in different countries on an irregular timeline.
choices.B: In 2015, professors Aaliyah Washington and James Wilson established the Global Nomad Symposium, which has held conferences in 2015, 2017–18, 2021, and 2023–24.
choices.C: The term symposium traditionally refers to a scholarly conference that occurs annually at a fixed location, not to conferences held at rotating venues with varying schedules.
choices.D: Symposiums have been held at Harvard, Oxford, and Stanford but also at universities in different countries around the world.

explanation: Choice A is the best answer. The sentence effectively emphasizes a difference between the Global Nomad Symposium and traditional symposiums, stating that the Global Nomad Symposium is unlike traditional symposiums because it rotates between universities in different countries on an irregular timeline.
